scripts.build:packages: pnpm --filter @openlearn/domain run build && pnpm --filter @openlearn/application run build && pnpm --filter @openlearn/identity run build && pnpm --filter @openlearn/persistence run build && pnpm --filter @openlearn/mcp run build
